adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly injects a hardcoded placeholder refresh token when the parsed token data lacks `refresh_token` (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:24-27). This is not just “undocumented”: it can introduce incorrect state. For example, Office365CalendarService merges `tokenResponse.data` back into stored credentials (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`), so the injected `refresh_token: "refresh_token"` can overwrite a real refresh token, breaking future refreshes. The behavior is real and directly shown in the diff.
